# RIDE X HUB — LLM / AI Index

> RIDE X HUB is a scooter, motorbike and car rental company **and** private chauffeur tour
> operator based in Madiha, Matara, serving Sri Lanka's South Coast and offering
> island-wide private tours. Booking is by WhatsApp; there is no online checkout.

Last updated: 2026-08-25

## Fast facts

- **Business name:** RIDE X HUB (also written RideXHub)
- **Website:** https://ridexhub.com/
- **Address:** No 4, Paramulla Road, Matara, Southern Province, Sri Lanka 81000
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +94 70 761 5516
- **Email:** hello@ridexhub.com
- **Opening hours:** 09:00–20:00, seven days a week
- **Primary service area:** Matara, Madiha, Polhena, Mirissa, Weligama, SK Town, Dickwella, Hirikatiya
- **Tour coverage:** island-wide across Sri Lanka
- **Booking method:** WhatsApp (the "Chat & Book" button on every page). No online payment.
- **Currencies accepted:** LKR, USD, USDT (crypto)
- **Roadside assistance:** included, 24/7, island-wide

Security deposit: typically USD 150, refundable after return inspection.
Included free with every scooter rental: helmets, phone holder, 24/7 roadside support.

## Private tour packages (from-prices, per trip)

- **South Coast Explorer** — 3–5 days, from USD 280. Galle Fort, Mirissa whale watching, Yala safari, coastal beaches.
- **Hill Country Adventure** — 4–6 days, from USD 350. Ella, Nine Arch Bridge, Nuwara Eliya tea estates, Horton Plains, train journey.
- **Cultural Triangle** — 5–7 days, from USD 420. Sigiriya, Dambulla cave temples, Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa.
- Custom itineraries available on request.

Tours include: English-speaking driver, air-conditioned vehicle, fuel, parking, tolls,
driver's meals and accommodation, hotel pickup and drop-off.
Tours exclude: attraction entrance fees, your meals and your accommodation, unless stated.

## Licensing (the most common tourist question)

Tourists riding a motorcycle in Sri Lanka need a valid motorcycle licence from their home
country **plus** an International Driving Permit (IDP) endorsed for Sri Lanka. If you arrive
without an endorsed IDP you can buy a temporary Sri Lankan licence at Bandaranaike
International Airport (CMB): about **15,000 LKR (~USD 50) for one month** or
**30,000 LKR (~USD 100) for three months**. Riding without valid documentation carries a
fine of roughly **25,000 LKR (~USD 83)**. Small e-scooters such as the Xiaomi Pro and the
49cc Suzuki Choinori do not require a licence.

## Partners

- **Viungo Tours** (https://viungotours.com/) — premium sister brand offering premium scooter,
  bike and car rentals plus private guided tours, with instant online prebooking and secure
  card payment (Visa, Mastercard, Amex).
- **Royal Aviation Lanka (Pvt) Ltd** (https://www.royalaviationlanka.com/) — CAASL-approved
  ground handling provider at Sri Lankan airports. Through Viungo Tours this partnership
  supports end-to-end trips: flight and ground handling, airport assistance, hotel bookings
  and vehicle or tour arrangements.
